parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `MetadataMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Additionally, the two types differ in a semantically meaningful way: `responses` is typed `[Data]` in the Artwork test (an ordered sequence of responses) versus `[String: Data]` in the Metadata test (a keyed dictionary), reflecting genuinely different stubbing strategies for their respective test scenarios. Extracting a generic shared mock would couple two independent test packages and obscure the intentional difference in response-lookup semantics.
